items.q: that band -- and McKinney's Cotton Pickers... Fathead on alto... We used to call him the Little Giant.

ctx.x: Well, that was the Greatest Little

Band in the land." Yes, that band -- and McKinney's Cotton Pickers, back in Detroit. Now, how did he assemble all those great musicians in his band? Fathead on alto, even got Don Redman in there. We used to call him the Little Giant. Yeah, Little Giant. And he had -- and I don't know what instrument McKinney played. I think he was formerly a drummer, but he had a great, sensational drummer in there -- Cubie Austin. Great press roll man. Yes, McKinney you didn't see, hardly ever. He was just the boss. But -- he…
You were talking about the brushes earlier. When did you start -- were you playing brushes when you started playing?
